Shadow Hearts   |                                         Yuri's Gravestones
     [W-S-05]      |
___ ___ ___ ___ ___|___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
|||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
   Valuables | [_] Air Gravestone      [_] Water Gravestone
             | [_] Earth Gravestone
_____________|_________________________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

At this point in the game, we can now obtain all but one Gravestone, which we
will obtain just moments after beginning the next story section.

Here's how to find the remaining Gravestones...


   Dark Gravestone   (Blue Castle)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You should've already picked this up. It was at the top of the tower in the
Blue Castle where you fought Yuri.


   Fire Gravestone   (Calios Mental Hospital)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You should've already picked this up. It was in the chest that you found the
Dungeon Key in the Calios Mental Hospital. You had to examine it a second time
to pick it up.


  Light Gravestone   (Nemeton Monastery)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You will be able to pick this up in the first house you see to the left in the
Nemeton Monastery once you start W-2-12 - Nemeton Monastery (1). It'll be
inside the house, past the vending machine.


    Air Gravestone   (Prague)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Make your way to Prague and enter the bar. Talk to the Owner and he'll say that
Darcie's been in the bathroom for a while, so go into the men's room and
examine the second stall. Watch the events here, and as long as you have some
Tissues in your inventory, Yuri will give them to him to help him out. Attempt
to leave the bar, and you'll receive the [_AIR GRAVESTONE_] as a thank you from
him. Just make sure to wash it off, as well as your hands...

  NOTE     If you don't want to waste a Lottery Ticket to get the Tissues, you
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   can get some later on by winning the Pit Fight with Margarete (once
           it becomes available), or you can win them from the Buggy enemies in
           the Cave Temple.


  Earth Gravestone   (Bistritz)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Visit Bistritz and go to the right side of the village. Examine the sparkling
sprout outside of the shop, then go inside and talk to Nina to learn more about
it. Go back outside and examine it once again.

_______________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
   ———>   [1] Quietly watch over it.    <———
          ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [2] Step on it.
_______________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

MAKE SURE TO CHOOSE 1! Once you do, leave Bistritz, then come back. Continue to
choose 1 and leave the village, repeating the process until Nina is waiting for
you beside the plant. Once she is, talk to her to receive the
[_EARTH GRAVESTONE_].


  Water Gravestone   (Rouen)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Take a trip to Rouen and go into the Inn and go up the stairs for a quick
scene. Go through the door on the right and talk to both Indignant Mary and
Upset John, then make your way to the church and enter the confessional in the
back. Upset John will come in and ask you what you think he should do.

_________________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [1] Get her a diamond, as promised.

   ———>   [2] It's about love, not the ring.      <———
          ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [3] Maybe it'd be better to split up.
_________________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Make sure to choose 2, otherwise you'll be forced to pay for the Water
Gravestone, 3,000 Cash if you choose 1, and 10,000 Cash if you choose 3.

In any case, once you can leave the church, head back to the Inn and into the
room, where you'll find John and Mary. John will thank you for your words, and
he'll give you the [_WATER GRAVESTONE_] as a thank you for saving his marriage.
(If you chose 1, you'll have to pay 3,000 Cash.)

  NOTE     Wild John will be on the bottom-right of the first area if you chose
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   3 instead, and you can buy the Gravestone there.

  NOTE     If you don't do this event now, you may not be able to later
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   depending on how far you progress in the story. I strongly recommend
            doing it now, as you can miss out on a great accessory, as well as
           Margarete's best weapon, if you don't.





=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

That's it for Gravestones, so make your way to the Nemeton Monastery!
